title: Object - Stock Consolidation Transaction
description: Object describing a consolidation of stock positions

comments.description: Unstructured text comments related to and stored for the object

date.description: Date on which the transaction occurred

resulting_security_id.description: Identifier for the security that holds the consolidated balance from this transaction

security_ids.title: Consolidation Security IDs Array
security_ids.description: Array of identifiers for the security (or securities) being consolidation as a result of the transaction

reason_text.title: Reason for stock consolidation
reason_text.description: Free-form human-readable reason for stock consolidation
